title: Jahmyr Gibbs: The contract process was extremely stressful

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jahmyr Gibbs: The contract process was extremely stressful
sources.description: There was reason to believe that Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs was close to signing a contract extension on Thursday morning when he suited up for practice for the first time at training camp and those thoughts became a reality when news of an agreement broke later in the day.
